mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive when UNRATE < 5.0% for 2 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal occurs in > 40% of instances without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust economic expansion with strong production capacity and labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% or the Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% or the Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and RSAFS up) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a cooling economy that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the signal is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
